name: Site, Room, Rack, Network Element, Components
transaction_boundaries: Every standalone authoritative mutation uses one LLD-01 UnitOfWork and COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 receipt; receipt insertion precedes receipt-FK child rows and repositories/reducers never commit or create nested receipts.
CreateSite coordinates LLD-02 DispatchLocationService plus Site and one-to-one link inside the same outer UnitOfWork.
Device Reference regularization validates session-bound deliberate-action proof and current LLD-03 Device Reference state, then mutates only LLD-08 identity-resolution/Infrastructure rows.
Maintenance-derived Installed Component mutations validate current LLD-07 physical-consequence evidence and never write Inventory/Task state.
Workbook discovery/parsing/staging/export generation occur outside long writer locks; accepted selected workbook mutations revalidate through ordinary owner services in one atomic outer UnitOfWork.
failure_modes: stale revisions/fingerprints, cross-Site placement/Cloud, Rack occupancy, primary-IP races, containment cycles, component slot conflicts and archived targets fail before commit
dependency or cross-packet validation INDETERMINATE fails closed
required participant/audit/projection/replay failure rolls back the authoritative UnitOfWork
unsafe/locked/corrupt/unsupported workbook produces bounded failure evidence without source modification or domain mutation
process interruption after accepted workbook commit but before technical cleanup leaves valid authoritative state and retryable cleanup
review_evidence: Semantic construction completed with 76 domain acceptance, 48 failure-injection and 36 hostile-workbook cases.
V2 DTO, command, query, route, audit, job, transition, migration-allocation, artifact, module-map and traceability contracts are machine-addressable.
All 34 authoritative commands and 15 canonical queries have dedicated V2 leaves below the 12 KB leaf budget.
Legacy aggregate command/query files are retained only as nonnormative semantic synthesis; V2 leaves are implementation authority.
Provider-side V2 declarations in LLD-03, LLD-05, LLD-07 and LLD-12 remain global integrity-gate dependencies and are pinned here by exact expected signatures.
design_principle: Infrastructure registers physical truth without replacing operational identities. Placement, containment, Cloud assignment, descriptive IPs, reusable compatibility knowledge, installed-component history and workbook evidence remain independent authorities and never imply connectivity or another domain lifecycle fact.
